mechanisms.mechanism: an outer deadline does not bound an inner blocking wait such as CompletionService.take()
mechanisms.permanent_rule: every blocking primitive in a bounded operation derives its timeout from remaining monotonic deadline
mechanisms.regression_obligation: inject a never-completing worker and prove discovery/control returns within the declared deadline plus scheduler tolerance

mechanisms.evidence: BETA07 Play Protect incident plus AX15GO PR #6
mechanisms.mechanism: a correct invariant applied before later reconstruction/version patches can be silently reintroduced afterward
mechanisms.permanent_rule: stable invariants are re-applied or revalidated after all version-specific transforms; final artifact is the oracle
mechanisms.regression_obligation: apply a synthetic late patch that reintroduces stale identity and prove final gate repairs/rejects it

mechanisms.evidence: AX15GO PR #10; Linux passed first candidate while Windows exposed descriptor-semantics failure
mechanisms.mechanism: hash/readback can succeed from OS cache before acknowledged bytes are explicitly flushed; durability primitive may also differ by OS
mechanisms.permanent_rule: critical acknowledged artifacts/secrets require platform-qualified durable flush before COMMITTED; noncritical telemetry must not inherit blanket fsync cost
mechanisms.regression_obligation: Windows+Linux fault-injection test around stage/replace/receipt boundaries; COMMITTED forbidden before durable flush

mechanisms.evidence: G6.0.22 DPAPI secure_store flush gap recorded as NEXT_RELEASE_HARDENING_RUNTIME_UNCHANGED
mechanisms.mechanism: repairing documentation/adapters while silently implying a sealed deployed runtime changed creates false safety evidence
mechanisms.permanent_rule: sealed/runtime artifact remains unchanged unless rebuilt/rehashed/requalified; planned hardening must be labeled pending
mechanisms.regression_obligation: state/reporting test rejects FIELD_VERIFIED/FIXED claims when only next-release engineering files changed

mechanisms.evidence: dedicated BROWSER4G repository existed empty while PROJECT-DRAFTS remained canonical
mechanisms.mechanism: a newly created dedicated repository can be mistaken for authority and cause design/source reconstruction from an empty or stale tree
mechanisms.permanent_rule: repository promotion requires explicit authority migration manifest, source SHA/readback and single-writer authority handoff
mechanisms.regression_obligation: bootstrap resolver must reject placeholder repository as canonical while authority fence says NOT_AUTHORITY
